name: Jensen Huang

onTheRecord.finding: Bloomberg (June 27, 2024): the Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation held 69 million Nvidia shares at end-2022 (valued at more than $8B per FoundationMark) and 'has mostly given stock to a donor-advised fund at Schwab'; headline says Huang logs 1-hour weeks at the foundation. Grants to a DAF count as qualifying distributions but are not disclosed onward.

notes: Forbes profile (as of Sep 27, 2026): $194.9B, #7 in the world, Philanthropy Score 1, citizenship United States; Forbes notes gifts of $30M to Stanford and $50M (2022) to Oregon State. Giving Pledge: Huang does not appear on the official pledger-list page (checked Sep 27, 2026). Foundation: Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation, EIN 26-1551239, Palo Alto, private foundation (ruling 2008). ProPublica API (current_2026_09_16): tax period 2024-12 asset_amount $9,212,451,171, income $5,998,475,536; the TY2024 990-PF PDF is listed but its line data are not yet extracted. Latest extracted filing TY2023: total assets end $3,413,872,472 (all in corporate stock), grants paid $59,723,672, contributions received $57,733,100, minimum investment return $123,554,691, distributable amount $123,236,425, undistributed income for the year $120,910,620. TY2022: assets $1,011,788,263, grants paid $66,338,496, undistributed income $57,433,782. TY2021: assets $1,930,245,950, grants paid $31,473,289, undistributed income $62,669,286. The 'undistributed income' field is non-zero in every year 2019-2023; because foundations have until the end of the following year to satisfy the 5% requirement and the carryover schedule was not read, met5PercentMinimum is left null rather than asserted; payoutShortfallYears null for the same reason. Part VII-B flag dirindirintcd=Y in 2019 only; no text read. Lifetime giving: no figure seen.
